description_en: Updates the configuration of a Network Load Balancer (NLB) server group
description_zh: 更新 NLB 服务器组的配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun nlb update-server-group-attribute --server-group-id sgp-atstuj3rtoptyui0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateServerGroupAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The new name of the server group.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and must start with an uppercase letter, lowercase letter, or Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的服务器组名称。

长度为2~128个字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: server_group_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable connection draining. Valid values:

true: Enabled.

false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启连接优雅中断。取值：

true：开启。

false：不开启
parameters.name: connection_drain_enabled

parameters.help_en: The timeout period of connection draining. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 0 to 900
parameters.help_zh: 设置连接优雅中断超时时间。单位：秒。取值范围：0~900
parameters.name: connection_drain_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The scheduling algorithm. Valid values:

Wrr: weighted round-robin. Backend servers with higher weights receive more requests than those with lower weights.

Wlc: weighted least connections. Requests are distributed based on the weight and the number of connections to backend servers. If two backend servers have the same weight, the backend server that has fewer connections is expected to receive more requests.

rr: round-robin. Requests are distributed to backend servers in sequence.

sch: source IP hashing. Requests from the same source IP address are distributed to the same backend server.

tch: four-element hashing. It is consistent hashing based on four elements (source IP address, destination IP address, source port, and destination port). Requests from the same stream are distributed to the same backend server.

qch: QUIC ID hashing. Requests with the same QUIC ID are distributed to the same backend server.

QUIC ID hashing is supported only when the backend protocol is UDP
parameters.help_zh:
调度算法。取值：

Wrr：加权轮询，权重值越高的后端服务器，被轮询到的概率也越高。

Wlc：加权最小连接数，除了根据每台后端服务器设定的权重值来进行轮询，同时还考虑后端服务器的实际负载（即连接数）。当权重值相同时，当前连接数越小的后端服务器被轮询到的概率也越高。

rr：轮询，按照访问顺序依次将外部请求分发到后端服务器。

sch：源IP哈希：相同的源地址会调度到相同的后端服务器。

tch：四元组哈希，基于四元组（源IP、目的IP、源端口和目的端口）的一致性哈希，相同的流会调度到相同的后端服务器。

qch：QUIC ID哈希，支持将同一个QUIC ID的请求哈希到同一台后端服务器上。

仅后端协议为UDP时，支持选择QUIC ID哈希
parameters.name: scheduler

parameters.help_en:
The traffic scheduling policy in dual-stack mode:

NonAffinity (default): non-affinity mode. Traffic is forwarded to healthy backend servers based on the scheduling algorithm regardless of the IP protocol version of the source.
Affinity: affinity mode. Traffic is forwarded based on the IP protocol version of the request source. IPv4 requests are forwarded only to IPv4 backend servers, and IPv6 requests are forwarded only to IPv6 backend servers.
This parameter takes effect only when AddressIPVersion is set to DualStack
parameters.help_zh:
双栈模式下的流量调度策略：

NonAffinity（默认）：无亲和模式，转发时不区分来源的IP协议版本，按照调度算法向健康的后端转发。
Affinity：亲和模式，转发时根据请求来源的IP协议版本亲和转发，IPv4请求仅转发至IPv4后端，IPv6请求仅转发至IPv6后端。
仅AddressIPVersion为DualStack时，该参数生效
parameters.name: ip_version_affinity_mode

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable client IP preservation. Valid values:

true: Enabled.

false: Disabled.

If PreserveClientIpEnabled is set to false and the server group is associated with a TCPSSL listener, you cannot change the value of this parameter to true
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启客户端地址保持功能。取值：

true：开启。

false：关闭。

当PreserveClientIpEnabled参数取值为false且服务器组已关联TCPSSL监听时，不支持将该参数的值修改为true
parameters.name: preserve_client_ip_enabled

fields.help_en: The port of the backend server used for health checks. Valid values: 0 to 65535. A value of 0 indicates that the port of the backend server is used for health checks
fields.help_zh: 健康检查的后端服务器的端口。取值范围：0~65535。0表示使用后端服务器的端口进行健康检查
fields.name: health_check_connect_port

fields.help_en: The maximum timeout period for a health check response. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 1 to 300. Default value: 5
fields.help_zh: 健康检查响应的最大超时时间。单位：秒。 取值范围：1~300。 默认值：5
fields.name: health_check_connect_timeout

fields.help_en:
The domain name used for health checks. Valid values:
$SERVER_IP: the private IP address of the backend server.
domain: a specific domain name. The domain name must be 1 to 80 characters in length, and can contain only lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and periods (.).

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheckType is set to HTTP
fields.help_zh:
用于健康检查的域名。取值：
$SERVER_IP：使用后端服务器内网IP。
domain：指定特定域名。长度限制1~80个字符，只能使用小写字母、数字、短划线（-）、半角句号（.）。

仅HealthCheckType为HTTP时，该参数生效
fields.name: health_check_domain

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable health checks. Valid values:

true: Enabled.

false: Disabled
fields.help_zh:
是否开启健康检查，取值：

true：开启。

false：关闭
fields.name: health_check_enabled

fields.help_en: The response string for UDP listener health checks. The string can contain only letters and digits, with a maximum length of 512 characters
fields.help_zh: UDP监听健康检查的响应串。只允许包含字母、数字，最大长度限制为512个字符
fields.name: health_check_exp

fields.help_en:
The HTTP status codes returned for a healthy backend server. Separate multiple status codes with commas (,).
Valid values: http_2xx (default), http_3xx, http_4xx, and http_5xx.
This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheckType is set to HTTP
fields.help_zh:
健康状态返回码，多个状态码用半角逗号（,）分隔。
取值：http_2xx（默认值）、http_3xx、http_4xx和http_5xx。
仅HealthCheckType为HTTP时，该参数生效
fields.name: health_check_http_code

fields.help_en:
The HTTP version for health checks. Valid values: HTTP1.0 or HTTP1.1.

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheckType is set to HTTP
fields.help_zh:
健康检查HTTP协议版本，取值：HTTP1.0或HTTP1.1。

仅HealthCheckType为HTTP时，该参数生效
fields.name: health_check_http_version

fields.help_en:
The interval between two consecutive health checks. Unit: seconds. Default value: 5.

If HealthCheckType is set to TCP or HTTP, valid values are 1 to 50.

If HealthCheckType is set to UDP, valid values are 1 to 300. Set the interval to a value greater than or equal to the response timeout period to prevent UDP probe responses from being incorrectly identified as no response due to timeout
fields.help_zh:
健康检查的时间间隔。单位：秒，默认值：5。

HealthCheckType为TCP或者HTTP时，取值范围为：1~50。

HealthCheckType为UDP时，取值范围为：1~300，您需要设置间隔时间>=响应超时时间，以确保UDP探测回包不会因为超时而被误判为未响应
fields.name: health_check_interval

fields.help_en: The request string for UDP listener health checks. The string can contain only letters and digits, with a maximum length of 512 characters
fields.help_zh: UDP监听健康检查的请求串。只允许包含字母、数字，最大长度限制为512个字符
fields.name: health_check_req

fields.help_en:
The protocol used for health checks. Valid values:

TCP
HTTP
UDP
fields.help_zh:
健康检查协议。取值：

TCP
HTTP
UDP
fields.name: health_check_type

fields.help_en:
The health check path.

The path must be 1 to 80 characters in length, and can contain only letters, digits, and the characters `-/.%?#&=` and extended characters `_;~!（)*[]@$^:',+`. It must start with a forward slash (/).
This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheckType is set to HTTP
fields.help_zh:
健康检查路径。

长度为1~80个字符，只能使用字母、数字、字符`-/.%?#&=`以及扩展字符`_;~!()*[]@$^:',+`。 必须以正斜线（/）开头。
仅HealthCheckType为HTTP时，该参数生效
fields.name: health_check_url

fields.help_en: The number of consecutive successful health checks that must occur before a backend server is declared healthy (from fail to success). Valid values: 2 to 10
fields.help_zh: 健康检查连续成功多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由失败判定为成功。取值范围：2~10
fields.name: healthy_threshold

fields.help_en:
The health check method. Valid values: GET or HEAD.
This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheckType is set to HTTP
fields.help_zh:
健康检查方法，取值：GET或HEAD。
仅HealthCheckType为HTTP时，该参数生效
fields.name: http_check_method

fields.help_en: The number of consecutive failed health checks that must occur before a backend server is declared unhealthy (from success to fail). Valid values: 2 to 10
fields.help_zh: 健康检查连续失败多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由成功判定为失败。取值范围：2~10
fields.name: unhealthy_threshold

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and business rules. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the check succeeds, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会更新服务器组信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not set this parameter, the system uses RequestId as ClientToken. The value of RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

schema.description_en: The response for updating server group configuration
